OTPFieldRoot.description: Holds the code and shares it with the slots inside it, as a group (`role="group"`). It also renders a visually hidden text input that holds the whole code for the form, with the code's `name`, `pattern` and `required`.

props.value: The code. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the field. Focus moves on to the next slot once the new value shows, so an owner that doesn't take a change leaves focus where it was. It may be read from an answer that is loading or guessed over; one that fails is left to the app's `errored` region.
props.defaultValue: The code at first, when it isn't controlled; also what a form reset puts back.
props.onValueChange: Called whenever the code changes. Receives the code and details whose `reason` is `input-change` (typing, or a fill), `input-clear` (typing that emptied a slot, or a form reset back to empty), `input-paste` or `keyboard` (Backspace and Delete). It is called in a change of its own, so it may save or write something a loading question reads without holding the field.
props.disabled: Whether the slots can't be changed or focused. Also true inside a disabled FieldRoot. A field disabled while a slot has focus (`disabled={pending? check}`) gives focus back to a slot when it is enabled again, if focus hasn't moved elsewhere.
props.readOnly: Whether the slots can be focused and moved between but not changed. `readOnly={pending? check}` keeps the code as it is while it is checked, without losing focus.
props.required: Whether the code is needed for the form to be valid: every slot, and the hidden input, is then required.

dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the field is disabled.
dataAttributes.data-readonly: Present when the field is read-only.
dataAttributes.data-required: Present when the field is required.
dataAttributes.data-complete: Present when every slot is filled.
dataAttributes.data-filled: Present when at least one slot is filled.
dataAttributes.data-focused: Present while a slot has focus.
dataAttributes.data-touched: Inside a FieldRoot: present once focus has left the slots at least once.
dataAttributes.data-dirty: Inside a FieldRoot: present once the code has changed.
dataAttributes.data-valid: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field has been validated and is valid.
dataAttributes.data-invalid: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field is invalid.

OTPFieldInput.description: One character's slot: a native text input. Typing fills it and moves to the next; Backspace empties it (or the slot before, from an empty one) and moves back; Delete takes its character out; the arrow keys, Home and End move between slots, and Ctrl or Cmd with an arrow goes to the first slot or the first empty one. A paste or several characters at once are spread from it. Takes every attribute of an `<input>`; a `type` given here wins over `mask`, and an `aria-label` is kept on every slot but the first.

dataAttributes.data-filled: Present when this slot holds a character.
dataAttributes.data-complete: Present when every slot is filled.
dataAttributes.data-focused: Present while any slot of the field has focus.
dataAttributes.data-touched: Inside a FieldRoot: present once focus has left the slots at least once.
dataAttributes.data-dirty: Inside a FieldRoot: present once the code has changed.
dataAttributes.data-valid: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field has been validated and is valid.
dataAttributes.data-invalid: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field is invalid.

OTPFieldSeparator.description: A separator between groups of slots (`role="separator"`). It carries no behaviour.
